messages:
Maya Chen: Quick async check-in — afternoon edition. Content calendar updated (see link): https://docs.google.com/example. Please post what you did / blockers / today. Also we need final benchmark numbers for the launch post by EOD. @Alex can you confirm the hero stat?
Alex Rivera: Did hero image tweak, uploaded new assets to /s3/launch-assets. No blockers. I'll validate hero stat with analytics in a bit.
Jin Park: Finished draft of the benchmark writeup, left comments on the doc. Blocker: need final latency numbers for the Llama-v2 comparison. @Irene can you share the CSV from infra?
Irene Lopez: Pushing CSV now to the shared folder. FYI numbers are from last night run (batch size 8). Quick sample:
```
model,avg_latency_ms,p50,p90,throughput_qps
redwood-v1,42,40,78,120
llama-v2,115,110,210,45
```
Uploading full CSV to Google Drive.
Sam O'Neil: Reviewed draft, left a comment about tone for the benchmark section. No blockers on copy. Today: finalize CTAs and schedule social.
Alex Rivera: Confirmed hero stat: '2x lower median latency vs Llama-v2' is supported by p50 numbers above. Will add source footnote.
Maya Chen: Great — @Sam please add CTA variations: short, medium, long. We should A/B test. Also need a one-sentence TL;DR for the launch email.
Sam O'Neil: Drafted TL;DR options in the doc — short one: "Ship faster inference at half the latency and a fraction of the cost." Added two CTAs.
Jin Park: Updated benchmark writeup to reference exact test harness and quant settings. Small note: we used 4-bit quant for reed model runs.
Irene Lopez: Clarifying note: infra ran both fp16 and 4bit; CSV has both tabs. The 4bit numbers are the ones we plan to cite; they match internal SLOs.
Maya Chen: Thanks. Blocker check — anything stopping us from finalizing copy by 5pm PST?
Alex Rivera: None from my side. I need a quick review on the hero image crop — @Jin can you glance?
Jin Park: Will do in 10.
Sam O'Neil: I'll schedule the social posts once copy is final. ETA 5:30pm.
DeployBot: [deploy-notice] assets-batch-42 uploaded to prod-bucket at 1754323000.
Maya Chen: Awesome. If anything slips, ping here. Otherwise I'll compile final doc and post to #launch-ready tonight. :thumbsup:
